_comment: Every job the farmer can be given, and who else can do it (PlayerSystem.JOB_KINDS). `helpers` are the helper kinds in Game.HELPERS (animal = farmhand, tree = arborist, bloom = gardener) that do it in one tap for everything of their kind; `vehicles` are the vehicle jobs (data/catalog/vehicles.json `job`) that do it over an area. An action nobody else does says why in `reason`. A test fails for a job kind with no entry here, or an entry with neither helper nor reason, so a new farm action is never player-only by accident.

fertilize.reason: FarmVille had no helper for fertilizing; a plot is fertilized as a choice, one bag at a time

nurture.reason: a young one needs its own supply given by hand, and which one it gets is the point

vehicle.reason: it is the helper: a vehicle's pass over an area
